description: m6-01 seed case 3/5 (07 section 7.11): the harness reports it worked ([[fixture:accepted]]), but the Brain's own independent verification (verify.ts, BR-2) disagrees -- the real acceptance[].verify command below is deliberately made to fail (`false`, expect_exit 0). Proves the eval gate actually distinguishes a truthful failure from a scripted success, not just that the fixture adapter can be told to say 'accepted'.

prompt.objective: Exercise the case where the harness claims success but real verification fails.

acceptance.statement: A deliberately failing real acceptance check.
